experience.title: Site Reliability Specialist
responsibilities: Design, write, read, test, and correct code for new software
Provide day-to-day support for production systems and applications
Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems in a timely manner
Maintain accurate documentation of systems, processes, and incidents
Provide status reports and escalate issues when necessary to lead resource
Collaborate with other IT teams to identify and resolve cross-functional issues
Mentor and provide guidance to junior members of the team
